mapper.select: select count(*) from user_account u join user_role_binding urb on urb.user_id = u.id join resource_scope rs on rs.id = urb.scope_id join role_permission rp on rp.role_id = urb.role_id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where (u.id = #{actor} or u.username = #{actor}) and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and (urb.expires_at is null or urb.expires_at > current_timestamp) and (p.capability = #{capability} or p.capability = 'ADMIN') and rs.resource_type = 'GLOBAL' and rs.resource_id = '*'

select count(*) from user_account u join user_role_binding urb on urb.user_id = u.id join resource_scope rs on rs.id = urb.scope_id join role_permission rp on rp.role_id = urb.role_id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where (u.id = #{actor} or u.username = #{actor}) and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and (urb.expires_at is null or urb.expires_at > current_timestamp) and (p.capability = #{capability} or p.capability = 'ADMIN') and ( (rs.resource_type = 'GLOBAL' and rs.resource_id = '*') or (rs.resource_type = #{resourceType} and rs.resource_id = #{resourceId}) )
select count(*) from user_account where (id = #{actor} or username = #{actor}) and status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from user_account where (id = #{actor} or username = #{actor}) and id = 'user-system' and status = 'ACTIVE'
select id, username, display_name, status from user_account where (id = #{actor} or username = #{actor}) and status = 'ACTIVE'

select distinct r.name from user_account u join user_role_binding urb on urb.user_id = u.id join role r on r.id = urb.role_id where (u.id = #{actor} or u.username = #{actor}) and (urb.expires_at is null or urb.expires_at > current_timestamp) order by r.name

select distinct p.capability from user_account u join user_role_binding urb on urb.user_id = u.id join role_permission rp on rp.role_id = urb.role_id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where (u.id = #{actor} or u.username = #{actor}) and (urb.expires_at is null or urb.expires_at > current_timestamp) order by p.capability

select distinct rs.resource_type, rs.resource_id from user_account u join user_role_binding urb on urb.user_id = u.id join resource_scope rs on rs.id = urb.scope_id where (u.id = #{actor} or u.username = #{actor}) and (urb.expires_at is null or urb.expires_at > current_timestamp) order by rs.resource_type, rs.resource_id
select id, status from agent_instance where id = #{agentId} and status <> 'REMOVED'
select capability from agent_capability where agent_id = #{agentId} order by capability
